Significant Energy Savings for Your Home

Cut your summer electricity bills and make your home more comfortable with solar control window film.

Keep Your Home Cool and Your Bills Low

For Arizona homeowners, the cost of air conditioning during the long, hot summer can be staggering. Your windows are a major source of heat gain, allowing the sun's powerful infrared rays to bake your interiors and force your HVAC system to work overtime. Residential energy-saving window film is one of the most effective upgrades you can make to improve your home's energy efficiency and lower your bills.

The Science of Solar Heat Rejection

Our advanced solar control films are designed to block a significant percentage of the sun's total solar energy. By rejecting heat before it passes through your glass, the films maintain a cooler, more stable indoor temperature. This has a direct impact on your energy consumption.

  • Lower Energy Bills: By reducing the heat load on your home, window film can cut your cooling costs by up to 30%, putting real money back in your pocket every month.
  • Faster ROI: Compared to expensive options like window replacement, solar film offers a much quicker return on investment, often paying for itself in just a few years.
  • Increased HVAC Lifespan: Less work for your AC unit means less wear and tear, potentially extending its service life and reducing the need for costly repairs.

More Than Just Savings: A More Comfortable Home

The benefits of energy-saving film go beyond your monthly budget. By managing solar heat, you create a more comfortable and enjoyable living environment year-round.

  • Eliminate Hot Spots: Do you avoid certain rooms during the afternoon because they get too hot? Window film balances temperatures throughout your home, making every room usable and comfortable.
  • Reduce Glare: Enjoy natural light without the annoying glare on your TV and computer screens. See our page on glare reduction for more info.
  • Protect Your Interiors: Like our UV protection films, energy-saving films block 99% of UV rays, preventing your furniture and floors from fading.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is window film more cost-effective than new windows?

Yes, significantly. Window film can provide similar or even better solar performance than new double-pane windows at a fraction of the cost, typically 10-20% of the price of full window replacement.

Will a dark, mirrored film save more energy?

While darker films do reject more heat, modern ceramic and spectrally-selective films can offer incredible heat rejection without a dark or reflective appearance, preserving your home's natural light and views.

Are there any tax credits for installing energy-saving window film?

Yes, certain qualifying energy-efficient window films are eligible for federal tax credits under the Inflation Reduction Act. We can provide you with the necessary documentation for eligible products.
